9: # Agentic Browser
10: 
11: Browser automation for AI agents via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh). Uses Playwright under the hood with a simple `@e` ref system for element interaction.
12: 
13: ![Agentic Browser](https://cloud.inference.sh/app/files/u/4mg21r6ta37mpaz6ktzwtt8krr/01kgjw8atdxgkrsr8a2t5peq7b.jpeg)
14: 
15: ## Quick Start
16: 
17: > Requires inference.sh CLI (`belt`). [Install instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inference-sh/skills/refs/heads/main/cli-install.md)
18: 
19: ```bash
20: belt login
21: 
22: # Open a page and get interactive elements
23: belt app run agent-browser --function open --input '{"url": "https://example.com"}' --session new
24: ```
25: 
26: 
27: ## Core Workflow
28: 
29: Every browser automation follows this pattern:
30: 
31: 1. **Open** - Navigate to URL, get `@e` refs for elements
32: 2. **Interact** - Use refs to click, fill, drag, etc.
33: 3. **Re-snapshot** - After navigation/changes, get fresh refs
34: 4. **Close** - End session (returns video if recording)
35: 
36: ```bash
37: # 1. Start session
38: RESULT=$(belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
39:   "url": "https://example.com/login"
40: }')
41: SESSION_ID=$(echo $RESULT | jq -r '.session_id')
42: # Elements: @e1 [input] "Email", @e2 [input] "Password", @e3 [button] "Sign In"
43: 
44: # 2. Fill and submit
45: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION_ID --input '{
46:   "action": "fill", "ref": "@e1", "text": "user@example.com"
47: }'
48: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION_ID --input '{
49:   "action": "fill", "ref": "@e2", "text": "password123"
50: }'
51: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION_ID --input '{
52:   "action": "click", "ref": "@e3"
53: }'
54: 
55: # 3. Re-snapshot after navigation
56: belt app run agent-browser --function snapshot --session $SESSION_ID --input '{}'
57: 
58: # 4. Close when done
59: belt app run agent-browser --function close --session $SESSION_ID --input '{}'
60: ```
61: 
62: ## Functions
63: 
64: | Function | Description |
65: |----------|-------------|
66: | `open` | Navigate to URL, configure browser (viewport, proxy, video recording) |
67: | `snapshot` | Re-fetch page state with `@e` refs after DOM changes |
68: | `interact` | Perform actions using `@e` refs (click, fill, drag, upload, etc.) |
69: | `screenshot` | Take page screenshot (viewport or full page) |
70: | `execute` | Run JavaScript code on the page |
71: | `close` | Close session, returns video if recording was enabled |
72: 
73: ## Interact Actions
74: 
75: | Action | Description | Required Fields |
76: |--------|-------------|-----------------|
77: | `click` | Click element | `ref` |
78: | `dblclick` | Double-click element | `ref` |
79: | `fill` | Clear and type text | `ref`, `text` |
80: | `type` | Type text (no clear) | `text` |
81: | `press` | Press key (Enter, Tab, etc.) | `text` |
82: | `select` | Select dropdown option | `ref`, `text` |
83: | `hover` | Hover over element | `ref` |
84: | `check` | Check checkbox | `ref` |
85: | `uncheck` | Uncheck checkbox | `ref` |
86: | `drag` | Drag and drop | `ref`, `target_ref` |
87: | `upload` | Upload file(s) | `ref`, `file_paths` |
88: | `scroll` | Scroll page | `direction` (up/down/left/right), `scroll_amount` |
89: | `back` | Go back in history | - |
90: | `wait` | Wait milliseconds | `wait_ms` |
91: | `goto` | Navigate to URL | `url` |
92: 
93: ## Element Refs
94: 
95: Elements are returned with `@e` refs:
96: 
97: ```
98: @e1 [a] "Home" href="/"
99: @e2 [input type="text"] placeholder="Search"
100: @e3 [button] "Submit"
101: @e4 [select] "Choose option"
102: @e5 [input type="checkbox"] name="agree"
103: ```
104: 
105: **Important:** Refs are invalidated after navigation. Always re-snapshot after:
106: - Clicking links/buttons that navigate
107: - Form submissions
108: - Dynamic content loading
109: 
110: ## Features
111: 
112: ### Video Recording
113: 
114: Record browser sessions for debugging or documentation:
115: 
116: ```bash
117: # Start with recording enabled (optionally show cursor indicator)
118: SESSION=$(belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
119:   "url": "https://example.com",
120:   "record_video": true,
121:   "show_cursor": true
122: }' | jq -r '.session_id')
123: 
124: # ... perform actions ...
125: 
126: # Close to get the video file
127: belt app run agent-browser --function close --session $SESSION --input '{}'
128: # Returns: {"success": true, "video": <File>}
129: ```
130: 
131: ### Cursor Indicator
132: 
133: Show a visible cursor in screenshots and video (useful for demos):
134: 
135: ```bash
136: belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
137:   "url": "https://example.com",
138:   "show_cursor": true,
139:   "record_video": true
140: }'
141: ```
142: 
143: The cursor appears as a red dot that follows mouse movements and shows click feedback.
144: 
145: ### Proxy Support
146: 
147: Route traffic through a proxy server:
148: 
149: ```bash
150: belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
151:   "url": "https://example.com",
152:   "proxy_url": "http://proxy.example.com:8080",
153:   "proxy_username": "user",
154:   "proxy_password": "pass"
155: }'
156: ```
157: 
158: ### File Upload
159: 
160: Upload files to file inputs:
161: 
162: ```bash
163: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
164:   "action": "upload",
165:   "ref": "@e5",
166:   "file_paths": ["/path/to/file.pdf"]
167: }'
168: ```
169: 
170: ### Drag and Drop
171: 
172: Drag elements to targets:
173: 
174: ```bash
175: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
176:   "action": "drag",
177:   "ref": "@e1",
178:   "target_ref": "@e2"
179: }'
180: ```
181: 
182: ### JavaScript Execution
183: 
184: Run custom JavaScript:
185: 
186: ```bash
187: belt app run agent-browser --function execute --session $SESSION --input '{
188:   "code": "document.querySelectorAll(\"h2\").length"
189: }'
190: # Returns: {"result": "5", "screenshot": <File>}
191: ```

16: ## Basic Login Flow
17: 
18: Standard username/password login:
19: 
20: ```bash
21: #!/bin/bash
22: 
23: # Start session
24: SESSION=$(belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
25:   "url": "https://app.example.com/login"
26: }' | jq -r '.session_id')
27: 
28: # Get form elements
29: # Expected: @e1 [input type="email"], @e2 [input type="password"], @e3 [button] "Sign In"
30: 
31: # Fill credentials
32: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
33:   "action": "fill", "ref": "@e1", "text": "user@example.com"
34: }'
35: 
36: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
37:   "action": "fill", "ref": "@e2", "text": "'"$PASSWORD"'"
38: }'
39: 
40: # Submit
41: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
42:   "action": "click", "ref": "@e3"
43: }'
44: 
45: # Wait for redirect
46: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
47:   "action": "wait", "wait_ms": 2000
48: }'
49: 
50: # Verify login succeeded
51: RESULT=$(belt app run agent-browser --function snapshot --session $SESSION --input '{}')
52: URL=$(echo $RESULT | jq -r '.url')
53: 
54: if [[ "$URL" == *"/login"* ]]; then
55:   echo "Login failed - still on login page"
56:   exit 1
57: fi
58: 
59: echo "Login successful"
60: # Continue with authenticated actions...
61: ```
62: 
63: ## OAuth / SSO Flows
64: 
65: For OAuth redirects (Google, GitHub, etc.):
66: 
67: ```bash
68: #!/bin/bash
69: 
70: SESSION=$(belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
71:   "url": "https://app.example.com/auth/google"
72: }' | jq -r '.session_id')
73: 
74: # Wait for redirect to Google
75: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
76:   "action": "wait", "wait_ms": 3000
77: }'
78: 
79: # Snapshot to see Google login form
80: RESULT=$(belt app run agent-browser --function snapshot --session $SESSION --input '{}')
81: echo $RESULT | jq '.elements_text'
82: 
83: # Fill Google email
84: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
85:   "action": "fill", "ref": "@e1", "text": "user@gmail.com"
86: }'
87: 
88: # Click Next
89: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
90:   "action": "click", "ref": "@e2"
91: }'
92: 
93: # Wait and snapshot for password field
94: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
95:   "action": "wait", "wait_ms": 2000
96: }'
97: RESULT=$(belt app run agent-browser --function snapshot --session $SESSION --input '{}')
98: 
99: # Fill password
100: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
101:   "action": "fill", "ref": "@e1", "text": "'"$GOOGLE_PASSWORD"'"
102: }'
103: 
104: # Click Sign in
105: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
106:   "action": "click", "ref": "@e2"
107: }'
108: 
109: # Wait for redirect back to app
110: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
111:   "action": "wait", "wait_ms": 5000
112: }'
113: 
114: # Verify we're back on the app
115: RESULT=$(belt app run agent-browser --function snapshot --session $SESSION --input '{}')
116: URL=$(echo $RESULT | jq -r '.url')
117: echo "Final URL: $URL"
118: ```

120: ## Two-Factor Authentication
121: 
122: For 2FA, you may need human intervention or TOTP generation:
123: 
124: ### With TOTP Code
125: 
126: ```bash
127: # After password, check for 2FA prompt
128: RESULT=$(belt app run agent-browser --function snapshot --session $SESSION --input '{}')
129: ELEMENTS=$(echo $RESULT | jq -r '.elements_text')
130: 
131: if echo "$ELEMENTS" | grep -qi "verification\|2fa\|authenticator"; then
132:   # Generate TOTP code (requires oathtool)
133:   TOTP_CODE=$(oathtool --totp -b "$TOTP_SECRET")
134: 
135:   # Fill 2FA code
136:   belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
137:     "action": "fill", "ref": "@e1", "text": "'"$TOTP_CODE"'"
138:   }'
139: 
140:   # Submit
141:   belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
142:     "action": "click", "ref": "@e2"
143:   }'
144: fi
145: ```
146: 
147: ### With Manual Intervention
148: 
149: For SMS or hardware token 2FA:
150: 
151: ```bash
152: # Record video so user can see the 2FA prompt
153: SESSION=$(belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
154:   "url": "https://app.example.com/login",
155:   "record_video": true
156: }' | jq -r '.session_id')
157: 
158: # ... login flow ...
159: 
160: # At 2FA step, prompt user
161: echo "2FA code sent. Enter the code:"
162: read -r CODE
163: 
164: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
165:   "action": "fill", "ref": "@e1", "text": "'"$CODE"'"
166: }'
167: ```

169: ## Session Reuse Patterns
170: 
171: Since sessions maintain cookies, you can reuse authenticated sessions:
172: 
173: ```bash
174: #!/bin/bash
175: # login-and-work.sh
176: 
177: # Login once
178: login() {
179:   SESSION=$(belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
180:     "url": "https://app.example.com/login"
181:   }' | jq -r '.session_id')
182: 
183:   # ... login steps ...
184: 
185:   echo $SESSION
186: }
187: 
188: # Do work with authenticated session
189: do_work() {
190:   local SESSION=$1
191: 
192:   # Navigate to protected page
193:   belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION --input '{
194:     "action": "goto", "url": "https://app.example.com/dashboard"
195:   }'
196: 
197:   # Extract data
198:   belt app run agent-browser --function snapshot --session $SESSION --input '{}'
199: }
200: 
201: # Main
202: SESSION=$(login)
203: do_work $SESSION
204: 
205: # Don't close if you want to reuse!
206: # belt app run agent-browser --function close --session $SESSION --input '{}'
207: ```

209: ## Cookie Extraction
210: 
211: Extract cookies for use in other tools:
212: 
213: ```bash
214: # Get cookies via JavaScript
215: RESULT=$(belt app run agent-browser --function execute --session $SESSION --input '{
216:   "code": "document.cookie"
217: }')
218: COOKIES=$(echo $RESULT | jq -r '.result')
219: echo "Cookies: $COOKIES"
220: 
221: # Get all cookies including httpOnly (more complete)
222: RESULT=$(belt app run agent-browser --function execute --session $SESSION --input '{
223:   "code": "JSON.stringify(performance.getEntriesByType(\"resource\").map(r => r.name))"
224: }')
225: ```

227: ## Security Best Practices
228: 
229: ### 1. Never Hardcode Credentials
230: 
231: ```bash
232: # Good: Use environment variables
233: '{"action": "fill", "ref": "@e2", "text": "'"$PASSWORD"'"}'
234: 
235: # Bad: Hardcoded
236: '{"action": "fill", "ref": "@e2", "text": "mypassword123"}'
237: ```
238: 
239: ### 2. Use Secure Environment Variables
240: 
241: ```bash
242: # Set securely
243: export PASSWORD=$(cat /path/to/secure/password)
244: 
245: # Or use a secrets manager
246: export PASSWORD=$(vault read -field=password secret/app)
247: ```
248: 
249: ### 3. Don't Log Sensitive Data
250: 
251: ```bash
252: # Good: Redact sensitive info
253: echo "Logging in as $USERNAME"
254: 
255: # Bad: Logging passwords
256: echo "Password: $PASSWORD"  # Never do this!
257: ```
258: 
259: ### 4. Close Sessions After Use
260: 
261: ```bash
262: # Always clean up
263: trap 'belt app run agent-browser --function close --session $SESSION --input "{}" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
264: ```
265: 
266: ### 5. Use Video Recording for Debugging Only
267: 
268: Video may capture sensitive information:
269: 
270: ```bash
271: # Only enable when debugging
272: if [ "$DEBUG" = "true" ]; then
273:   RECORD_VIDEO="true"
274: else
275:   RECORD_VIDEO="false"
276: fi
277: ```
278: 
279: ### 6. Verify Login Success
280: 
281: Always confirm authentication worked:
282: 
283: ```bash
284: # Check URL changed from login page
285: URL=$(echo $RESULT | jq -r '.url')
286: if [[ "$URL" == *"/login"* ]] || [[ "$URL" == *"/signin"* ]]; then
287:   echo "ERROR: Login failed"
288:   exit 1
289: fi
290: 
291: # Or check for specific element on authenticated page
292: ELEMENTS=$(echo $RESULT | jq -r '.elements_text')
293: if ! echo "$ELEMENTS" | grep -q "Logout\|Dashboard\|Welcome"; then

5: ## Base Command
6: 
7: All commands follow this pattern:
8: 
9: ```bash
10: belt app run agent-browser --function <function> --session <session_id|new> --input '<json>'
11: ```

13: - `--function`: Function to call (open, snapshot, interact, screenshot, execute, close)
14: - `--session`: Session ID from previous call, or `new` to start fresh
15: - `--input`: JSON input for the function

17: ## Functions
18: 
19: ### open
20: 
21: Navigate to URL and configure browser. This is the entry point for all sessions.
22: 
23: ```bash
24: belt app run agent-browser --function open --session new --input '{
25:   "url": "https://example.com",
26:   "width": 1280,
27:   "height": 720,
28:   "user_agent": "Mozilla/5.0...",
29:   "record_video": false,
30:   "show_cursor": false,
31:   "proxy_url": null,
32:   "proxy_username": null,
33:   "proxy_password": null
34: }'
35: ```
36: 
37: **Input Fields:**
38: 
39: | Field | Type | Default | Description |
40: |-------|------|---------|-------------|
41: | `url` | string | required | URL to navigate to |
42: | `width` | int | 1280 | Viewport width in pixels |
43: | `height` | int | 720 | Viewport height in pixels |
44: | `user_agent` | string | null | Custom user agent string |
45: | `record_video` | bool | false | Record video (returned on close) |
46: | `show_cursor` | bool | false | Show cursor indicator in screenshots/video |
47: | `proxy_url` | string | null | Proxy server URL |
48: | `proxy_username` | string | null | Proxy auth username |
49: | `proxy_password` | string | null | Proxy auth password |
50: 
51: **Output:**
52: 
53: ```json
54: {
55:   "session_id": "abc123",
56:   "url": "https://example.com",
57:   "title": "Example Domain",
58:   "elements": [...],
59:   "elements_text": "@e1 [a] \"More information...\" href=\"...\"\n...",
60:   "screenshot": "<File>"
61: }
62: ```
63: 
64: ### snapshot
65: 
66: Re-fetch page state with `@e` refs. Call after navigation or DOM changes.
67: 
68: ```bash
69: belt app run agent-browser --function snapshot --session $SESSION_ID --input '{}'
70: ```
71: 
72: **Output:** Same as `open` (url, title, elements, elements_text, screenshot)
73: 
74: ### interact
75: 
76: Perform actions on the page using `@e` refs.
77: 
78: ```bash
79: belt app run agent-browser --function interact --session $SESSION_ID --input '{
80:   "action": "click",
81:   "ref": "@e1"
82: }'
83: ```
84: 
85: **Input Fields:**
86: 
87: | Field | Type | Description |
88: |-------|------|-------------|
89: | `action` | string | Action to perform (see Actions table) |
90: | `ref` | string | Element ref (e.g., `@e1`) |
91: | `text` | string | Text for fill/type/press/select |
92: | `direction` | string | Scroll direction: up, down, left, right |
93: | `scroll_amount` | int | Scroll pixels (default 400) |
94: | `wait_ms` | int | Wait duration in milliseconds |
95: | `url` | string | URL for goto action |
96: | `target_ref` | string | Target ref for drag action |
97: | `file_paths` | array | File paths for upload action |
98: 
99: **Actions:**
100: 
101: | Action | Required Fields | Description |
102: |--------|-----------------|-------------|
103: | `click` | `ref` | Single click |
104: | `dblclick` | `ref` | Double click |
105: | `fill` | `ref`, `text` | Clear input and type text |
106: | `type` | `text` | Type text without clearing |
107: | `press` | `text` | Press key (Enter, Tab, Escape, etc.) |
108: | `select` | `ref`, `text` | Select dropdown option by label |
109: | `hover` | `ref` | Hover over element |
110: | `check` | `ref` | Check checkbox |
111: | `uncheck` | `ref` | Uncheck checkbox |
112: | `drag` | `ref`, `target_ref` | Drag from ref to target_ref |
113: | `upload` | `ref`, `file_paths` | Upload files to file input |
114: | `scroll` | `direction` | Scroll page (optional: `scroll_amount`) |
115: | `back` | - | Go back in browser history |
116: | `wait` | `wait_ms` | Wait for specified milliseconds |
117: | `goto` | `url` | Navigate to different URL |
118: 
119: **Output:**
120: 
121: ```json
122: {
123:   "success": true,
124:   "action": "click",
125:   "message": null,
126:   "screenshot": "<File>",
127:   "snapshot": {
128:     "url": "...",
129:     "title": "...",
130:     "elements": [...],
131:     "elements_text": "..."
132:   }
133: }
134: ```
135: 
136: ### screenshot
137: 
138: Take a screenshot of the current page.
139: 
140: ```bash
141: belt app run agent-browser --function screenshot --session $SESSION_ID --input '{
142:   "full_page": true
143: }'
144: ```
145: 
146: **Input Fields:**
147: 
148: | Field | Type | Default | Description |
149: |-------|------|---------|-------------|
150: | `full_page` | bool | false | Capture full scrollable page |
151: 
152: **Output:**
153: 
154: ```json
155: {
156:   "screenshot": "<File>",
157:   "width": 1280,
158:   "height": 720
159: }
160: ```
161: 
162: ### execute
163: 
164: Run JavaScript code on the page.
165: 
166: ```bash
167: belt app run agent-browser --function execute --session $SESSION_ID --input '{
168:   "code": "document.title"
169: }'
170: ```
171: 
172: **Input Fields:**
173: 
174: | Field | Type | Description |
175: |-------|------|-------------|
176: | `code` | string | JavaScript code to execute |
177: 
178: **Output:**
179: 
180: ```json
181: {
182:   "result": "Example Domain",
183:   "error": null,
184:   "screenshot": "<File>"
185: }
186: ```
187: 
188: **Examples:**
189: 
190: ```bash
191: # Get page title
192: '{"code": "document.title"}'
193: 
194: # Count elements
195: '{"code": "document.querySelectorAll(\"a\").length"}'
196: 
197: # Extract text
198: '{"code": "document.querySelector(\"h1\").textContent"}'
199: 
200: # Get all links
201: '{"code": "Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(\"a\")).map(a => a.href)"}'
202: 
203: # Scroll to bottom
204: '{"code": "window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)"}'
205: 
206: # Get computed style
207: '{"code": "getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor"}'
208: ```
209: 
210: ### close
211: 
212: Close the browser session. Returns video if recording was enabled.
213: 
214: ```bash
215: belt app run agent-browser --function close --session $SESSION_ID --input '{}'
216: ```
217: 
218: **Output:**
219: 
220: ```json
221: {
222:   "success": true,
223:   "video": "<File or null>"
224: }
225: ```
226: 
227: ## Key Combinations
228: 
229: For the `press` action, use these key names:
230: 
231: | Key | Name |
232: |-----|------|
233: | Enter | `Enter` |
234: | Tab | `Tab` |
235: | Escape | `Escape` |
236: | Backspace | `Backspace` |
237: | Delete | `Delete` |
238: | Arrow keys | `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight` |
239: | Modifiers | `Control`, `Shift`, `Alt`, `Meta` |
240: 
241: **Key combinations:**
242: 
243: ```bash
244: # Ctrl+A (select all)
245: '{"action": "press", "text": "Control+a"}'
246: 
247: # Ctrl+C (copy)
248: '{"action": "press", "text": "Control+c"}'
249: 
250: # Shift+Tab (focus previous)
251: '{"action": "press", "text": "Shift+Tab"}'
252: ```
253: 
254: ## Error Handling
255: 
256: When an action fails, `success` is `false` and `message` contains the error:
257: 
258: ```json
259: {
260:   "success": false,
261:   "action": "click",
262:   "message": "Unknown ref: @e99. Run 'snapshot' to get current elements.",
263:   "screenshot": "<File>",
264:   "snapshot": {...}
265: }
266: ```
267: 
268: Common errors:
269: - `Unknown ref: @eN` - Ref doesn't exist, re-snapshot needed
270: - `'text' required for fill action` - Missing required field
271: - `'target_ref' required for drag action` - Missing drag target
272: - `Timeout 5000ms exceeded` - Element not found or not clickable", "references/proxy-support.md": "1: # Proxy Support
